_comment: Edit this file to add / remove / rename your ACOMS portals. Each portal needs a unique 'id', a display 'name', a short 'tagline', and the 'url' to open.
_summaryComment: 'summary' is optional: the path to that portal's GET /api/launcher/summary route. A portal with one is polled for things waiting on you and can raise notifications; a portal without one is just a link, exactly as before. Add the key as each app grows the route.
_doubleCheckUrls: NOTE: the email, gis and controller URLs below were guessed during setup. Please double-check that acoms-email, acoms-gis and acoms-controller point at the right deployments before trusting them.
_quickNoteComment: The Quick Note strip has two halves. 'new' jumps to a fresh note (compose=1); 'view' opens the Quick Notes list. Both need the matching Controller update deployed. Change the base URLs here if Controller moves.
_viewsComment: 'views' (optional, per portal) are named pages that get their own half of the tile and their own window: 'id', 'label', 'tagline', a root-relative 'path', and 'maximize' to open it filling the screen. WIP's Scheduler is the first. Any tile can also open a second window: the + on the right, or Shift-click.
_chatComment: 'chat' is optional: which portal hosts the chat routes (POST <sync> is what the launcher polls). Remove the block and the launcher simply has no chat.
_chatJobsComment: 'chat.jobs' (optional): an A-number typed in a chat message (A1174, A1016B) links to <that portal's url><path><number>. Remove it and A-numbers stay plain text.
_tasksComment: 'tasks' (optional): the local Tasks window and its tray icon (src/tasks.js). 'portal' hosts GET <sync>, the one call that feeds the window; 'jobs' is where a task's A-number links (as chat.jobs); 'email' is the portal a task's source email opens in. Admins only for now. Remove the block and there is no Tasks window.
_localOnlyComment: 'localOnly': true marks a portal that runs on this computer (an http://127.0.0.1 address), not on Vercel. Its tile shows only while it answers on 'probe' - so the Brain Console appears on the computers that run it (Dion's, JD's) and nowhere else. See src/local-portals.js.
